questions.q: Who travels home to Ndotsheni with Kumalo?
choices: The little boy (Gertrude's son) and the girl, Absalom's wife
questions.explain: The girl carries her 'worldly possessions in one of those paper carriers.'

questions.q: What does Kumalo tell the little boy when he asks for his mother?
choices: That she has gone away — and the boy does not ask again
questions.explain: Gertrude vanished on the morning of their departure.

questions.q: What does Kumalo say to his wife when she meets him and looks her question?
choices: 'Our son is to die, perhaps there may be mercy, but let us not talk of it now'
questions.explain: He also tells her Gertrude is gone: 'Let us not talk of it now.'

questions.q: How does Kumalo's wife receive the girl?
choices: She embraces her 'after the European fashion' and says, 'You are my daughter'
questions.explain: The girl bursts into weeping and says, 'Mother, that is all that I desire.'

questions.q: How is Kumalo welcomed back at Ndotsheni?
choices: Women of the church in white dresses with green cloths sing a hymn of thanksgiving, and people run down from the hills calling out
questions.explain: 'One woman... runs to the hut, calling and crying more like a child than a woman, It is the umfundisi that has returned.'

questions.q: Why does a child tell Kumalo they are glad he is back, rather than the young priest the Bishop had sent?
choices: 'We did not understand him. It is only our umfundisi that we understand.'
The young priest stole from them
questions.explain: The people's love for Kumalo, despite his son's crime, is made plain.

questions.q: What hard thing does Kumalo bring himself to pray aloud, before the whole congregation?
choices: For the death of the murderer
'And Tixo, my son... Forgive him his trespasses'
questions.explain: 'It is done, it is out, the hard thing that was so feared.'

questions.q: What does the new teacher want to sing that the old teacher says 'has not come here yet'?
questions.explain: The old teacher is 'cold with this new teacher, and she is ashamed too, because she does not know' it.

questions.q: What does Kumalo also pray for in this homecoming service?
choices: Rain, and protection against hunger and starvation if the rain does not come
questions.explain: The valley is in the grip of drought; 'our mealies are nearly finished.'

choices: Addressing the small boy: 'Call and dance... For this is a prelude, it is only a beginning.'
questions.explain: 'It is life you are going into, you are not afraid because you do not know.'
